_description: SaaS KPI Tiers — tiered onboarding catalog for SaaS Premium vertical. Each tier is a curated KPI set that matches a customer's integration maturity.
_note: Tier names are prefixed 'SaaS' for clarity. DC2_S will get its own tier config when needed.

saas_starter_9.description: Minimal viable KPI set for 1-hour self-service onboarding. Covers all 6 Power-of-1 ROI metrics. No product analytics integration required.

saas_predictive_11.description: Behavioral Gold set. Adds Golden Path Velocity (product stalling detection) and Persona Breadth (single-point-of-failure protection). Requires product analytics integration.
capabilities_unlocked: Single Point of Failure simulation (Persona Breadth)
Friction vs Value gap analysis (Golden Path + NPS)

saas_growth_15.description: Full Amplitude integration. Adds Feature Adoption Breadth, Login Frequency, Workflow Completion Rate, and Module Activation Rate for deep product usage intelligence.
capabilities_unlocked: Feature adoption depth analysis (which features drive retention)
Login frequency anomaly detection (disengagement early warning)
Workflow completion funnel analysis (friction point identification)
saas_growth_15.prerequisites: CRM + support + full Amplitude/Mixpanel integration (event tracking, user flows, feature flags)

saas_full_43.description: Complete enterprise catalog. All 5 pillars including P4 (Partner & Ecosystem). Full simulation engine, board-ready NRR forecasting.
saas_full_43.prerequisites: All integrations: CRM, support, product analytics, partner portal, billing
